description: WRITE: stage (insert or replace) a catalog spec inside a draft. Edits only the draft — live pipelines are unaffected until the draft is published. Estuary control-plane: POST /draft_specs (upsert on draft_id,catalog_name). Returns the staged row.

catalog_name.description: The catalog name of the entity being staged (e.g. acmeCo/inventory/products).

draft_id.description: The draft id to stage the spec into.

spec.description: The catalog spec JSON object (passed through verbatim).

spec_type.description: The entity type of the staged spec.

name: estuary_upsert_draft_spec
title: Upsert draft spec
